cases.title: Team page lists every workspace member with role/status; KPI tiles match DB counts
Invite modal: opens/cancels; empty and malformed email are blocked (no request); roles radios incl. Super Admin for owner
Invite a Manager: modal closes, confirmation banner; DB has INVITED user with role, invitation row and magic-login token
Inviting an existing member shows the server error in the modal (409), stays open
Search and status filter narrow the member table
Change role (owner): Manager -> Admin saved to DB; Save button only after a change
Deactivate agent -> INACTIVE in DB and cannot log in; Reactivate restores ACTIVE
Revoke a pending invite: Revoke button marks the invited user INACTIVE/removed; self row has no Deactivate
Permissions modal: toggling a permission saves custom_permissions (DB) and the user's access changes; Reset restores defaults
Permanent delete: Cancel keeps user, OK removes the row from DB
ADMIN view: no role dropdowns, no Permissions buttons; API refuses admin role changes and Super Admin invites (403)
Team API 500 on user list shows an error state, not an empty team
Reports renders KPIs and campaign table for a campaign with sends; no NaN/undefined
Date range buttons (7d/30d/90d/365d) re-query with the matching start_date
Export CSV / Export Word / campaign Export CSV trigger file downloads
User filter dropdown (All Users) lists workspace users and filters the report
Reports API 500 does not crash (error boundary not shown)
MANAGER (view_analytics) can open Reports; AGENT is redirected Home
